verdict.rationale: Orama's docs state that Orama Cloud officially supports JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust SDKs. The open-source JS library is installable via npm, yarn, pnpm and bun, with documented create, insert, search and answer APIs. The docs also say those APIs are designed to mirror the Cloud APIs. missing for 10: in-depth evidence on the Python and Rust SDKs beyond a single mention, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
